# The Shadows Are Born — Narrative Script

*Audio: 02_The_Shadows_Are_Born.mp3 — July 22, 2026*

---

Six thousand years before the Common Era, on Old Earth, a group of pre-philosophers gathered at a campfire in the Middle East. They asked the first questions. What is the soul? What is consciousness? What lies beyond death?

They found answers. Those answers gave them power — power over minds, power over bodies, power that transcended death itself. They became the Hybrian Shadows.

The Shadows played the long game. They infiltrated every civilization. They engineered every collapse. By 2030, they controlled Earth. By the time the Last Great War ended three million years later, they had consumed hundreds of thousands of galaxies.

The campfire never went out. It just found new things to burn.

---
